issues.quote: **مخاطره‌کاهی جامعگی و اخلاقی؛ societal and ethical risk mitigation**
issues.explanation: The section header writes «مخاطره‌کاهی» (with ezafe connector ـِ between the two components) instead of the form printed in the standard. Evidence T23684-3.3.1 prints «مخاطره کاهی جامعگی و اخلاقی» as a two-word compound without ezafe; the terminology table also specifies «(AS PRINTED)» and instructs «print as is; do not fix.» Adding an ezafe changes the printed form in violation of the binding rule.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «مخاطره‌کاهی جامعگی و اخلاقی» with «مخاطره کاهی جامعگی و اخلاقی» (space, no ezafe) to match the printed form in T23684-3.3.1 and the terminology table.
